d := b * b - 4 * a * c
    denominator := real64(2 * a)
    numerator := real64(-b)
    if d > 0
        root := math.sqrt(real64(d))
        first := (numerator + root) / denominator
        second := (numerator - root) / denominator
        if first < second
            first, second = second, first
